summary.text: Patient F, a male aged 68, presented with a closed transverse patellar fracture classified as AO 34C1, considered a fragility fracture resulting from a fall from standing height. The patellar fracture displacement was 20 mm.

Open reduction and internal fixation used cannulated screws with suture tape augmentation, with an operation time of 40 minutes, performed within one week of injury. After the operation the knee was protected with a cylinder slab or knee brace for two weeks.

Union time was 10 weeks and no complications were recorded at one year follow-up. At four months the knee range of motion was 0–105 and the Knee Society Score was 91. Follow-up lasted 13 months. Mild difficulty performing full squats was reported without problems rising from a seated position or performing daily activities.
